registers.label: Spare
lines: On the night of the lamb's blood and the broken bread.
God passed over us and set us free.
We eat with our staff in hand, ready to go.
This is the night the Lord brought us out.
Where two or three gather in my name, says Jesus.
There I am, in the midst of them.
Come, let us worship the God who gathers us.
We come; you are among us. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Taste the bread eaten in a hurry, the lamb roasted in the dark, the meal of a people about to be set free.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
The blood on the doorpost, the staff in hand, the sandals on your feet — this is the night the Lord passes over.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
Out of slavery into the open country God led them, a whole people remembering this meal ever after.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
And Jesus makes a smaller, surer promise for us: wherever even two come together in his name, he is in the midst.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here. Thanks be to God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The lamb, the blood, the bread eaten in haste.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
This is the night the Lord brought us out.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
Where two or three meet in my name, says Jesus.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here.
Come, let us worship the God in our midst.
Where two or three gather, Christ is here. Amen.
